Политику обучили на 200 аккуратных поезд: A policy was trained on 200 clean operator drives down the center of the road; the validation error is small. What happens when the policy drives on its own?
Поедет так же точно, как на валидации: It drives as precisely as on validation
Небольшая ошибка уведёт её туда, где при: A small error takes it where there are no examples, and the errors start to pile up
Поедет точнее оператора: сеть усредняет: It drives more precisely than the operator: the network averages out his jitter
Политика сама выбирает, какие состояния: The policy chooses which states it will see. Off the route there are no examples, and in the worst case the error per episode grows as the square of the path length. Validation on the operator's frames does not show this.
Put the DAgger steps in order.
Обучить политику на демонстрациях экспер: Train the policy on expert demonstrations
Пустить политику ехать самой и записать: Let the policy drive on its own and record the states it ends up in
Попросить эксперта разметить эти состоян: Ask the expert to label those states with the correct actions
Добавить новые примеры к старым и переоб: Add the new examples to the old ones and retrain the policy
Едет политика, размечает эксперт: так пр: The policy drives, the expert labels: that is how examples appear where the policy ends up on its own. Steps two through four are repeated several times.
DAgger: едет политика, размечает эксперт: DAgger: the policy drives, the expert labels
Половина операторов объезжает чайник сле: Half of the operators pass the kettle on the left, half on the right. An MSE regression was trained on 4,000 such drives instead of 40. What changes?
Ада начнёт объезжать чайник: Ada starts going around the kettle
Ада ещё точнее поедет посередине между о: Ada drives even more precisely down the middle between the two detours, that is, into the kettle
Ада будет выбирать сторону случайно: Ada picks a side at random
Минимум MSE — условное среднее. Среднее: The MSE minimum is the conditional mean. The mean of the left and right detours passes through the kettle, and more data does not fix that: the network just hits the middle more precisely.
Диффузионную модель обучили на точках дв: A diffusion model was trained on points from two spirals. Where does a sample generated from noise end up?
В середину между спиралями: In the middle between the spirals
Денойзер оценивает, откуда пришла зашумл: The denoiser estimates where the noisy point came from: under heavy noise it pulls toward the mean, under light noise toward the nearest spiral. So the sample lands in one of the modes, not in their average.
Куда сдвигать точку на обратном пути: Where to move the point on the way back
Что Diffusion Policy строит из шума?: What does Diffusion Policy build from noise?
Кадры камер на следующий шаг: Camera frames for the next step
Из гауссова шума за несколько шагов дено: A few denoising steps turn Gaussian noise into an action chunk. Observations are never noised: frames and the robot's pose are only the condition.
В команде из четырёх слов слова перестав: In a four-word command the words were shuffled and the positional encodings removed. Does the attention output change?
Не изменится: без позиций внимание не зн: No: without positions, attention has no notion of order
Ответ внимания — сумма значений с весами: The attention output is a weighted sum of values, and a sum does not depend on the order of its terms. Order comes from the positional encodings.
Внимание не знает порядка: Attention has no notion of order
Зачем ACT латентная переменная z из CVAE: Why does ACT need the latent variable z from the CVAE?
Чтобы при обучении сжать манеру оператор: To compress the operator's style during training and avoid averaging different styles; at inference z = 0
Чтобы на выводе добавлять случайность и: To add randomness at inference and try different motions
Чтобы быстрее строить пачку на выводе: To build the chunk faster at inference
Люди показывают задачу по-разному. При о: People demonstrate a task in different ways. During training the CVAE encoder compresses the style into z, and the policy does not mix styles. At inference z = 0, and ACT is deterministic.
Чему учится сеть во flow matching?: What does the network learn in flow matching?
Скорости, с которой точка движется по пр: The velocity at which a point moves along the straight line from noise to data
Шуму, который добавили к данным: The noise that was added to the data
Номеру шага, на котором точка станет дан: The step number at which the point becomes data
Обучение — регрессия: на прямой между сл: Training is regression: on the straight line between a random noise sample and a random data point the network predicts the velocity. Generation is a few Euler steps through the learned field.
Скорость на прямой от шума к данным: Velocity on the line from noise to data
Политика съезжает с дороги. Что поможет: The policy drifts off the road. What helps the most?
Ещё столько же аккуратных поездок по цен: The same number of clean drives down the center again
Примеры возвратов: кадры в стороне от ма: Recovery examples: frames off the route and the correct action from them
Аккуратные поездки не показывают состоян: Clean drives never show the states an error leads to. Recoveries are added by a noisy operator, shifted frames and side cameras.
Как добавить в данные возвраты: How to add recoveries to the data
Почему с человеком-экспертом вместо DAgg: Why is HG-DAgger often used instead of DAgger when the expert is a human?
Размечать действия по видео, где рулит к: Labeling actions on a video where someone else is driving is hard, so the human takes over the controls when they see danger
Человек размечает быстрее программы: A human labels faster than a program
DAgger не работает на настоящих роботах: DAgger does not work on real robots
При разметке «со стороны» нет обратной с: Labeling “from the outside” gives no feedback, and the quality of human labels drops. In HG-DAgger the human intervenes directly, and the segments they drove go into the data.
Почему людям неудобен DAgger: Why DAgger is awkward for humans
Почему роботам хватает 4–16 шагов генера: Why do robots get by with 4–16 generation steps instead of 1,000 as in DDPM?
Они шагают так, чтобы предсказанное не т: They step so that the prediction is not lost: DDIM and similar solvers on the same network
Действия проще картинок, поэтому шагов D: Actions are simpler than images, so you can just take fewer DDPM steps
Роботы генерируют только последний шаг: Robots generate only the last step
Если просто сократить шаги DDPM, облако: If you simply cut the DDPM steps, the cloud collapses toward the center. DDIM and other solvers take large deterministic steps with the same network, and distillation and flow matching cut them down even further.
Diffusion Policy строит пачку из 16 шаго: Diffusion Policy builds a 16-step chunk and executes 8. What happens if all 16 are executed before the next pass?
Робот позже заметит, что сцена изменилас: The robot notices a change in the scene later
Робот начнёт вилять между стратегиями: The robot starts weaving between strategies
Ничего: пачка уже всё учла: Nothing: the chunk has already accounted for everything
Отступающий горизонт — компромисс. Корот: The receding horizon is a trade-off. Short execution lets the strategy switch at the seams, long execution delays the reaction to changes in the scene. The authors execute half the chunk.
π0 тратит на вывод 73 мс, а новое действ: π0 spends 73 ms on inference, yet a new action arrives every 20 ms. How does that add up?
Модель выдаёт пачку из 50 действий, а за: The model outputs a chunk of 50 actions and runs twice a second
Вывод идёт сразу на нескольких видеокарт: Inference runs on several GPUs at once
π0 подаёт моменты на моторы напрямую, бе: π0 sends torques to the motors directly, without inference
Пачка отделяет частоту управления от час: The chunk decouples the control rate from the inference rate: 50 actions at 20 ms each is a second of motion, and the model is called once every 0.5 s. The KV cache speeds up every call.
Одна пачка ведёт руку в обход вазы слева: One chunk takes the arm around the vase on the left, the next one on the right. Temporal ensembling averages them on the overlap. What happens?
Рука пойдёт посередине, прямо на вазу: The arm goes down the middle, straight into the vase
Рука выберет более свежую пачку: The arm picks the fresher chunk
Temporal ensembling сглаживает движение,: Temporal ensembling smooths the motion, but it also averages different strategies, and the mean of two detours leads into the obstacle. That is why chunk seams are reconciled, as in RTC, rather than averaged.
Модель flow matching без reflow запустил: A flow matching model without reflow is run with a single Euler step from noise. Where does the point end up?
В среднее данных, между пятнами: At the mean of the data, between the blobs
Обучающие прямые пересекаются, и сеть уч: The training lines cross, and the network learns their average, so the generation paths are curved and a single step from noise lands at the mean of the data. Reflow straightens the paths, and one or two steps are almost enough.
Сорок операторов объезжают чайник: полов: Forty operators drive around the kettle: half on the left, half on the right. Pick the model and the chunk length so that over 10 drives Ada never touches the kettle and never switches sides at the kettle.
Регрессия с MSE усредняет объезды и едет: MSE regression averages the detours and drives into the kettle with any chunk. A Gaussian mixture keeps both sides, but if the side is picked at every step or in short chunks, Ada jumps between them. A chunk of 24 steps or more holds the chosen side to the end of the detour.
